ChromaTaskbar 1.0.0 runs in the Windows notification area and adapts the taskbar to the foreground maximized application.

Highlights:
- Background startup with tray controls for settings, pause/resume, and safe exit.
- Representative colour sampling with smoothed transitions.
- Transparent taskbar on the desktop, restored windows, and Windows shell surfaces.
- Original TranslucentTB settings are backed up before changes and restored on normal exit.
- Windows x64 installer and portable package include the .NET runtime.

TranslucentTB must be installed and running. See README.md and INSTALLATION.md for setup and testing instructions.
